intro: We met again after a long time, and a weekend in Dubai is where it finally happened. My brother and I began with iced coffee in the shade of the stone arches, with nowhere else to be and the whole afternoon still ahead of us.
paragraph: The reunion did not need a plan. One table in the shade was enough, and the first iced coffee went quickly while the afternoon settled in around us.
Later the shade moved along the arches, and we moved with it. My brother stayed close the whole time, and nobody looked at the clock.
As the sun shifted, the stone walls turned a deeper gold. It was an ordinary hour, made rare by how long it had taken us to get here.
Toward the end we found a bench under the arches and let the last of the ice melt slowly. Nothing about that hour asked us to hurry.
Before leaving, we walked the length of the shaded walkway side by side, cups nearly empty, still in no rush to be anywhere else.
The light softened as the afternoon wore on, and the walkway grew quiet around the two of us and our nearly finished drinks.

closing: A weekend in Dubai gave us one unhurried afternoon, and it was enough. We left with empty cups and the same easy quiet we had started with, side by side. We met again after a long time; this book keeps that afternoon close.
